newsitem.title: USA: Two Va. att'y gen. candidates seek to end lottery.
newsitem.headline: Two Va. att'y gen. candidates seek to end lottery.

text.p: Two Republican candidates running for Virginia's attorney general said they want to repeal the state lottery, the Washington Post reported on Monday.

Four candidates are seeking the Republican nomination for attorney general in a primary June 10, the Post reported. Jerry Kilgore, a former state secreatry of public satety, and Sen. Mark Earley, D-Chesapeake, oppose the lottery.
Opponents of lottery repeal say the state's $332 million in lottery profits last year would be impossible to replace, leading to deep cuts in education or other services, the Post reported.
